name: Hidden traitor
summary: Players get secret roles; the traitors blend in and sabotage, and everyone discusses and votes to eject suspects.
core_loop: reveal roles → do tasks → discuss → vote → eject → check win
rules: crew wins by tasks or ejecting all traitors
win: crew finish tasks or eject traitors
social_hooks: play in a Group chat night
example_prompts: among us but in our group chat
mafia for 6 friends
werewolf at a sleepover
among us with hogwarts students

name: Act it out
summary: Players act out a secret word without speaking while teammates guess before the timer ends.
core_loop: see word → act → team guesses → mark correct or skip → next
content_needs: word bank by category and difficulty
example_prompts: heads up with harry potter characters
charades for my family reunion
act it out game for movies

name: Draw and guess
summary: One player draws a secret word; others guess in chat, and earlier correct guesses score more.
core_loop: get word → draw on canvas → others guess → timer → reveal → rotate
rules: drawer scores for each correct guess
example_prompts: skribbl but only hogwarts words
pictionary with my group chat
draw something with my cousins
draw and guess about school

name: Telephone drawing
summary: A phrase passes along a chain: draw it, caption the drawing, draw the caption, and the end result is compared to the start.
core_loop: write phrase → friend draws → next friend captions → next draws → reveal chain
rules: each player sees only the previous item
example_prompts: broken picturephone for my friends
draw the phrase and pass it
gartic phone about monsters

name: Hot potato
summary: A bomb with a hidden fuse passes between players; each pass requires a quick task, and whoever holds it when it pops loses.
core_loop: bomb arrives → complete a tiny task → pass → fuse random → boom
example_prompts: pass the bomb with harry potter words
hot potato for my group chat
tick tock boom but on my phone

name: Truth or dare spinner
summary: Spin to pick a player and a card (truth, dare, or confess); prompts are tuned for the group and keep it friendly.
core_loop: spin → pick truth or dare → read prompt → do it or pass → next
example_prompts: truth or dare for a school sleepover
spin the bottle but friendly
dares for my class group chat

name: Never have I ever
summary: Players read a statement; everyone who has done it marks it, and the group sees counts and who is outnumbered.
core_loop: statement shown → each taps have/have not → counts appear → laugh
rules: tallies are shown only as counts unless players opt in
example_prompts: never have i ever at school edition
most surprising confession counts
never have i ever for my study group

name: Two truths and a lie
summary: A player writes three statements about themselves, one false; others vote on which is the lie.
core_loop: write 3 statements → others vote → reveal the lie → scores
rules: the author scores for fooling people
example_prompts: two truths and a lie with my roommates
guess which one is false about me
group lie spotting game

name: Fake answer bluff
summary: A weird fact with a blank is shown; everyone writes a fake answer, then all answers and the real one are voted on.
core_loop: read prompt → write fake answers → shuffled with the real one → vote → points
rules: you cannot vote for your own
example_prompts: fibbage about harry potter facts
write fake answers to fool my friends
balderdash with weird science facts

name: Caption judge
summary: A prompt or picture is shown; players submit captions or cards; the judge picks the funniest and rotates.
core_loop: prompt shown → players submit → judge picks → winner scores → judge rotates
example_prompts: caption contest for school photos
apples to apples but clean
meme caption battle with friends

name: Word association chain
summary: Each player says a word associated with the previous word within a few seconds without repeats or hesitation.
core_loop: see start word → type a related word → timer → next player → no repeats
rules: words must relate (validated by player votes or a list)
example_prompts: word association chain about pokemon
say a word connected to the last one fast
associations with my friends

name: Clue-giver teams
summary: A clue-giver gives a one-word clue for a number of words on the board; teammates guess, avoiding the trap word.
core_loop: clue-giver sees key → gives clue and number → team taps matching words → reveal → next
rules: clue cannot be on the board
social_hooks: team vs team on a call
example_prompts: codenames with harry potter words
one word clues for my group
spymaster game for 4 friends

name: One doesn't know
aliases: Fake Artist Goes to New York
summary: Everyone gets the same secret location or word except one player; players ask and answer questions to expose the outsider without revealing the secret.
core_loop: everyone sees the word except the spy → players ask questions → vote on the spy → spy guesses the word
rules: questions must be vague enough to hide the word
lose: outsider avoids vote or guesses the word
example_prompts: spyfall with school places
chameleon with harry potter words
one player has no idea what the word is

name: Dial wavelength
summary: A clue-giver sees a hidden target on a spectrum (hot to cold) and gives a clue; teammates set the dial where they think the target is.
core_loop: see target → give clue → team sets dial → reveal → closer scores
social_hooks: compare how well you read each other
example_prompts: wavelength with hogwarts spectrums
guess where the target is on a spectrum
cool to uncool dial with my friends

name: Cooperative clue dedupe
summary: A guesser faces a secret word; all others write one-word clues, and duplicate clues are removed before the guesser sees them.
core_loop: guesser sees blanks → clue-givers type clues → duplicates removed → guesser sees remaining → guess
social_hooks: team with friends in a chat
example_prompts: just one but with pokemon names
co-op clues where duplicates cancel
one-word clue game with my friends

name: Category and letter
summary: A letter and a list of categories; fill in an answer per category, with answers that match another player's scoring zero.
core_loop: letter shown → type one answer per category → compare → unique ones score
rules: answers must start with the letter
example_prompts: scattergories with harry potter categories
category and letter game with my class
name place animal thing but modern

name: Closest guess
summary: An item or number is shown; each player secretly guesses a value, and the closest without going over (or just the closest) wins.
core_loop: item shown → guess a number → reveal → closest scores → next
example_prompts: guess the price of school lunches
price is right with pokemon items
estimate the number of jelly beans

name: Emoji decode
summary: A movie, song or phrase is shown as emoji; the group decodes it before time runs out.
core_loop: emoji string shown → type guess → timer → reveal → next
example_prompts: emoji decode for harry potter
guess the movie from emojis
send emoji puzzles to my group chat

name: Mishear decode
summary: A string of odd words sounds like a phrase when said aloud; players decode the real phrase.
core_loop: odd text shown → read aloud or sound out → type the phrase → check
social_hooks: read the text aloud with friends
example_prompts: mad gab but with harry potter spells
misheard lyrics decode game
decode weird sounding phrases for my family

name: Survey feud
summary: A survey question was asked of many people; guess the top answers, with more popular answers scoring more.
core_loop: question shown → type answer → matches popular ranking → points
example_prompts: family feud about school
survey says for my group chat
top 10 answers for hogwarts

name: Mini challenge round
summary: A rapid-fire set of short challenges (shake, balance, tap, hold) where players compete for the best score on each.
core_loop: challenge prompt → everyone does it → scores recorded → next → sum
social_hooks: pass the phone or share scores
example_prompts: minute to win it with school items
wario ware style rounds with friends
party challenges to pass the phone around

name: Liar's dice
summary: Players secretly roll dice then bid on the total counts across all hands; each raise must go up, and a challenge reveals who lied.
core_loop: roll hidden → bid count and face → next player raises or calls → reveal → loser loses a die
example_prompts: liars dice with pirates
bluffing dice for a sleepover
perudo with my friends

name: Mind meld
summary: Players tap or choose without communicating; the goal is to land on the same item or the same order.
core_loop: countdown → choose silently → reveal → matches score → next
social_hooks: see how in sync friends are
example_prompts: mind meld with my best friend
pick the same answer without talking
same wavelength game for the group chat

name: Bomb defusal talk
summary: One player sees a bomb with modules; the others have the manual; they talk it through to defuse before time runs out.
core_loop: defuser describes a module → manual holders instruct → defuser acts → timer
example_prompts: keep talking and nobody explodes with my friends
spaceteam style co-op
defuse a cake bomb with one person reading

name: Odd one out
summary: Most players see the same prompt; one sees a slightly different one; all give answers, then vote on who is the odd one.
core_loop: prompts → everyone writes an answer → answers revealed → vote → reveal
rules: the odd prompt is similar not identical
example_prompts: undercover with school words
find who got a different prompt
odd one out game for my class

name: Story-dice improv
summary: Roll symbol dice and tell a story that must include them, in turns, within a short time.
core_loop: roll symbols → player tells a story piece → timer → pass → vote best
social_hooks: voice message stories in a Group
example_prompts: story cubes with harry potter symbols
improv a story from random pictures
tell a story using these dice

name: Most likely to
summary: A prompt like 'most likely to oversleep' is shown; everyone votes for a friend, and results reveal the Group's opinion.
core_loop: prompt shown → pick a friend → votes tallied → reveal winner
example_prompts: most likely to for our group chat
who is most likely to be late
friends vote on the funniest

name: Describe and draw
summary: One player describes a hidden image in words; the partner draws what they hear without seeing it; the two compare.
core_loop: describer sees image → describes → drawer draws → compare to original
example_prompts: describe and draw with my brother
draw what i describe without looking
blind drawing game with friends

name: Emoji relay
summary: A message is passed along a chain, each player re-expressing it in emoji or a few words, and the original and final are compared.
core_loop: read message → rewrite in emoji → next friend decodes → reveal
rules: each player sees only the last output
example_prompts: emoji telephone with my friends
pass a message and see what survives
pass the secret message through the group

name: Roast and toast
summary: Spin to pick a friend, then pick from a list a compliment or a gentle roast to send; the friend rates it.
core_loop: spin → pick friend → choose compliment or roast → send → friend reacts
example_prompts: roast and toast for my group chat
compliment spinner for friends
kind roasts for a birthday

name: Group photo scavenger
summary: A list of silly things to find or pose with; players snap them and the Group votes on the best.
core_loop: prompt list → find the thing → snap or tick → Group votes → points
example_prompts: scavenger hunt for our sleepover
photo bingo for a school trip
find silly things around the house

name: Rhythm circle
summary: A rhythm pattern is passed around; each player repeats it and adds one beat; the first to miss is out.
core_loop: hear pattern → repeat on beat → add a beat → pass
example_prompts: clap circle on my phone
pass a rhythm around my friends
rhythm memory game for a party

name: Rank-it consensus
summary: Players individually rank a list; the game compares rankings and rewards the closest to the group consensus.
core_loop: list shown → rank → reveal group average → closest scores
social_hooks: guess how the Group ranks things
example_prompts: rank these pizza toppings like my friends
group consensus ranking game
rank hogwarts houses with my class

name: Confidence wager
aliases: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire lifeline
summary: Players answer, then wager points on their confidence, with larger wagers risking more.
core_loop: question → answer → set wager → reveal → points updated
example_prompts: jeopardy final wager with my friends
bet on how sure you are
wager game on movie trivia

name: Gift match
summary: Wrapped gifts are opened in turns; each player either opens a new one or steals a revealed gift from someone, with a steal limit.
core_loop: open or steal → reveal gift → steal limit → final holdings
rules: a gift can be stolen up to 2 times
last player may swap with anyone
win: end with a gift you like
example_prompts: white elephant for our class
secret santa gift steal game
gift exchange for the group chat
